en.heading: Auto service website FAQ

cards.heading: What should an auto repair or detailing website include?
cards.text: Clear service pages, real work examples, location and opening hours, contact options, trust signals and a fast way to request a booking or quote.

cards.heading: Can you create separate pages for each service?
cards.text: Yes. High-value services such as detailing, polishing, ceramic coating, PPF, diagnostics or maintenance can each have focused pages for stronger search intent and conversion.

cards.heading: Do you provide local SEO for auto services?
cards.text: Yes. We can structure service and location pages, improve metadata and internal linking, and prepare the website for local search. Specific rankings are never guaranteed.

cards.heading: Can enquiries go into a CRM?
cards.text: Yes. Forms can collect the requested service, vehicle information and contact details and feed them into a CRM-ready workflow for follow-up and source tracking.
